title: A further study of polynomial $g_{n,q}$ over finite fields
summary: Let $n\geq 0$ be an integer and $q$ a prime power. The polynomial $g_{n,q}$ was introduced in [10] with the purpose of finding new classes of permutation polynomials over finite fields. We investigate the permutation behaviour of the polynomial $g_{n,q}(X)$ over finite fields of even characteristic. We introduce the multivariate case of the polynomial $g_{n,q}$, and study the permutation polynomials in several variables and local permutation polynomials resulting from the polynomials $g_{n,q}(X_1,X_2,\ldots , X_k)$.
